InvoiceAppointment.body:
Dear Abu Auf Management Team,

Greetings,

Please find attached the final report for the maintenance works completed across Abu Auf branches during 2025/2026.

The submitted documents include:

  • A detailed schedule showing the branch, execution date, scope of work, quantities, and prices.
  • A summary of the total value of each receipt.
  • Supporting receipt images linked to their corresponding receipt numbers within the report.
  • Financial review and measurement tools included in the Excel file.

The total value of the completed works before Value Added Tax is EGP 795,765.00, in accordance with the attached details and supporting documents.

Kindly review and approve the submitted works and proceed with the required financial procedures.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
